programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Dream Children
programme.desc: Alex wants to become a father. Steven, his partner, has to confront his insecurities and fear of change after a lifetime smothered by superficiality. Unable to adopt legally, but still eager to become parents, they decide to turn to the black market, adopting a child from a desperate young woman, who's return with a dangerous new boyfriend, threatens to destroy everything they love.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Shanghai [English Dub]
programme.desc: A laborer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich. But ends up using his kung fu skills to survive. Remake of The Boxer From Shantung.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A man has an obsession that, if he is to die, it would be by being killed by a high school girl. With his strange obsession in mind, he decides to become a teacher.

programme.title: The Big Call [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ding Xiao Tian is a young policeman whose sole goal is to catch Lin A Hai, the leader of a ring that deals in phone scams, and have caused his high-school teacher to commit suicide after being bankrupted by them. Eventually, Ding finds himself a temporary member of the Anti-Telecommunication Fraud Centre in Donghai city, under the leadership of Tan Si Rong, who explains to him the actual size of Lin A Hai and his girlfriend’s, Liu Li Fang’s ring, which has spread to Hong Kong and Thailand, “succeeding” in hundreds of frauds, even including millionaires. At the same time, Ding Xiao Tian learns that an ex-classmate of his from the police academy, Xu Xiao Tu, has infiltrated the Thai headquarters of the ring, run by Liu Li Fang. The story then unfolds into three axes, one focused on the two police officers, the other on Xu Xiaotu and Liu Li Fang, and the last on Lin A Hai, who also experiences some struggles.

programme.title: Ghost Blows The Lamp of the Longling Temple [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shirley Yang returns to China in search of professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, only to find him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.

programme.title: Mad Cats [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On a quest to find his missing brother, Taka teams up with a quirky new friend and an edgy, mysterious girl to take on a pack of vicious assassins with 9 lives!

programme.title: Airpocalypse [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

programme.title: The Night Owl [English Dub]
programme.desc: A period drama film, depicting Joseon Dynasty in Korea. Kyoung-su is a skilled acupuncturist but a blind who can only see a little at dark. Right after Kyoung-su joins King Injo’s medical team, the prince comes back after 7 years of living in Chung dynasty. Due to a long journey coming back, the prince becomes ill, and the king’s doctor brings Kyoung-su to heal him. But while Kyoung-su is doing his work, he finds out the king’s hidden secret which might change everything that the king owns. Could Kyoung-su be able to save everyone and himself?

programme.title: The Witch: Subversion [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

programme.title: Yesterday Once More [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gu Yuxuan and Han Shuyan almost had a fated encounter when they were children. After they grew up, the two met again as they are destined to fall in love. After experiencing the happiness and sweetness of love, they had to face the test of fate together. Can the miracle of love keep them together?

programme.title: The Great Battle [English Dub]
programme.desc: Witness the epic Siege of Ansi, where Goguryeo warriors defend against 500,000 Tang soldiers in THE GREAT BATTLE.

programme.title: Confession [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in a hotel where only the two of them were present, and Min-ho is immediately singles out as the prime suspect. Insisting on his innocence, Min-ho hires the talented lawyer Shin-ae to defend him, and confesses to her that a car accident on the day before may be connected to Se-hee's murder...

programme.title: THE PRIESTS [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A priest and a skeptical young deacon try to save a girl who falls into a mysterious coma after a hit-and-run. Suspecting demonic possession, they perform an exorcism, but as they uncover the entity’s dark origins, they face a terrifying battle of faith and survival.

programme.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card [English Dub]
programme.desc: Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

programme.title: The Goblin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Doo-hyeon, who goes by the name the ''Goblin'', goes to prison for taking the fall for Yeong-min who killed their boss. Released after 10 years, Doo-hyeon had been living a normal life, until he found out Yeong-min had been taking advantage of his name. Yeong-min goes so far as to kidnap Doo-hyeon's daughter to keep his mouth shut. Enraged, Doo-hyeon seeks revenge and announces the return of the real ''Goblin''.

programme.title: HELTER SKELTER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Top star Lilico undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries to her entire body. As her surgeries show side effect.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is an iron rule in the Ching Hing Gang: No drug dealing. The gang leader, Yu Nam, has two right-hand men. One chooses to live in the bright world, while one is in the black. 15 yeas later, what will happen when they reunion?

programme.title: Upstream [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gao Zhilei's impulsive decision to become a stay-at-home husband leads to unforeseen challenges. As life takes a reverse turn, he's forced to face responsibilities as the family's breadwinner, ultimately finding himself and starting anew.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: Ditto [English Dub]
programme.desc: A story about the love and friendship that takes place in an era where a man and a woman communicate through radio by chance.

programme.title: Manhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In one neighborhood in Seoul, about 10 people disappeared without a trace over 6 months. As even the smallest clues remain as to where the missing people have gone and who took them, residents' anxiety grows. Meanwhile, unidentifiable hair and blood stains were found on the manhole cover! What on earth is happening inside the manhole that threatens our peaceful daily life?

programme.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon [English Dub]
programme.desc: In 1592, Admiral Yi Sun-sin uses the Turtle Ship to battle Japanese forces off Hansan Island. Epic naval clash ensues

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's

Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: In the premiere episode of Fund Tank, viewers are introduced to Charlie Cimitile, an enterprising entrepreneur with a passion for the burgeoning cannabis industry. With a background in medical device sales, Charlie shares his journey of starting Day 1 Distro, an ancillary cannabis distribution company on the East Coast. Facing financial challenges and a desire for rapid growth, Charlie pitches his business to a panel of investors, laying out his vision for expanding his product offerings and capturing a larger market share.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Guy Mounier, the CEO of Aptivio, seeks a $500,000 investment to expand his AI-driven lead generation business. Aptivio's AI engine, similar to ChatGPT, analyzes online behavior to identify potential clients. However, the investors express concerns about market saturation and the clarity of Aptivio's value proposition.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Chad Honeycutt, owner and CEO of Evidence-Based Classroom Solutions, pitches his business. Chad discusses how his company addresses the deficit in evidence-based services for students with disabilities, particularly autism and emotional disabilities, in public schools. Despite significant revenue growth, Chad seeks investment due to cash flow challenges, primarily caused by delays in insurance reimbursements. The panel expresses concerns about profitability and the need for clearer communication about the company's mission.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Phil Fogarty, owner of PSA Security, discusses his business struggles and funding needs with Joe Camberato, CEO of National Business Capital. Phil's security company faced challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic but pivoted successfully to provide social distance monitoring services, leading to significant revenue growth. Despite increasing demand, cash flow constraints hinder further expansion. Phil emphasizes his motivation to succeed for his family and seeks guidance on refining his pitch and understanding financial metrics.

programme.title: 7 Miles of Paradise
programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.
programme.desc: Rock jumps on Australia’s coast, then a wakesurf challenge to see who stays up longest.

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.
programme.desc: Jamie and Poopies try go-boats on NSW waves, get tossed, then skydive over the coast.

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.
programme.desc: New Zealand arrival: before surfing, Jamie starts with a fearsome bridge bungee in Auckland.

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.
programme.desc: NZ sand dunes: eyebrow challenge, skim boards, skis, and Poopies surfs in women’s lingerie.

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.
programme.desc: Shallow-river tow rides and sandy drags, then downhill rolls in giant inflatable balls.

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.

programme.title: Who Is J.O.B.
programme.desc: Jamie O’Brien and pals look back on Who Is J.O.B.—favorite stunts, pranks, and waves.

programme.title: Cluster
programme.desc: This is our bookmark. Our full stop. It is an actual document of individuality and modern surfing and living and romping and laughing. Collect it and recollect on it. Here we are now, entertain us. And well take it from there.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning Water Into Oil
programme.desc: I get quite a few questions about water-based finishes and how to make them look more like oil-based finishes. It’s a common problem since water-based finishes are “water-white,” which means they don’t impart any color to the wood and have the potential to leave the surface looking lifeless and boring. In this video, I show you three different ways to treat the wood surface so that even WITH a water-based topcoat, the wood looks more like an oil-based finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 5
programme.desc: I'll show you how I use a Kutzall carving burr and a die grinder to blend in the protruding center piece, and I discuss the creation of the template for the top. I also show you how I rout the grooves for the steel dowels that will suspend the tabletop in the middle of the piece (you’ll understand when you see it).

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: David Marks Project in Progress
programme.desc: This is a quick tour of David Marks project in progress. David loves to make massive turned sculptures and his current project is a doozie! It’s a huge disc-shaped turned piece featuring a big marquetry image on the front. I hope you enjoy this as much as I did. It’s almost like an episode of Woodworks! Well, sort of.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 2
programme.desc: I discuss sliding dovetails and show you how to make them. I also cover finessing the dovetail’s fit and some special techniques for creating a stopped sliding dovetails.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 10 Things I Wish I Knew When I Started Woodworking
programme.desc: Some tips that might save you some heartache, time and money.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: River Bend Windsor Chair Kit
programme.desc: My friends at the Woodwerks Supply in Ohio sent me one of their new River Bend Windsor Chair Kits. This video outlines the process of putting this kit together and I even go so far as to give you a few compelling reasons why a kit like this makes sense for new AND experienced woodworkers alike!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Dream Closet Build Part 1
programme.desc: Making my wife a dream closet to replace the builder grade wire shelving.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Classy Headphone Controller Rack
programme.desc: An elegant and simple rack that holes a game controller and a set of headphones.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Waterborne Finishes & HVLP
programme.desc: Technically, this is really Part 4 of our Wall-Hanging Tool Chest build, but because I focused so strongly on waterborne finishes and HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure spraying), it received its own stand-alone title.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Low Entertainment Center Part 1
programme.desc: Think you can’t build furniture because you only have a few basic tools? Well, check this out! This walnut low entertainment center was built using three primary tools: a circular saw, a router, and a drill. The unit has sliding doors, good ventilation, a little shelf in the back for a surge protector, and all of the trim is beveled at an angle for a more interesting visual effect

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flatten Boards Wider Than Your Jointer
programme.desc: I'm going to show you two techniques that will help you keep your wide boards intact. Both methods utilize the planer for final flattening, but one method starts with a hand plane and the other starts with the jointer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Natural Wood Color Changes aka A Colorful Conversation
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the science of natural wood color changes.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 12
programme.desc: Well I finally made it to the finish line. This episode covers the hinge installation, pegging the tenons in the doors, making custom ebony handles, and finishing. I end the video with a justification of my design.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Dining Chair
programme.desc: You might recall the Gaming Dining Table I built in season 9. Ever since then, Nicole has been asking repeatedly, "When do I get my chairs?" So I started designing a new chair that I'd eventually batch out for a total of six. The video I've assembled here is a quick look at the process of designing and building the chair.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Outdoor Finishes - Real World Results
programme.desc: A look at how my outdoor projects have fared over the years.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 3
programme.desc: In the final part of our series, Aaron puts the finishing touches on the trunk lid. If this is your first experience with SketchUp, I highly recommend checking out the tutorials located at Sketch Up For Woodworkers

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rocking Horse Part 2
programme.desc: The second and final video in this series covers finishing and assembly. As with any project, you should always ask yourself if it might be better to pre-finish the parts. Since the rocking horse would be incredibly difficult to finish after assembly and all of our parts are screwed together, pre-finishing was a no-brainer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Knife Case and Box Joint Jig
programme.desc: Got knives? Here's a cool way to store and display them!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Low Entertainment Center Part 2
programme.desc: If there is one major negative aspect to working with plywood and other sheetgoods, its the fact that we have to deal with the ugly exposed edges. But with a little know-how and some strips of wood, you can dress up the edges so that only a trained eye can tell that the board is not completely made of solid wood.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: So I Changed My Mind!
programme.desc: Over the years, I've changed my mind about finishes, workbench flatness, and some other things.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Update - Tool Wall - Garage Door Cover - New Fans - DC Upgrades
programme.desc: Almost before I realized what was happening, I found myself fully engaged in phase 2 of my garage to shop conversion. 2x4s were purchased, nails were driven, and organization was born!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Festool DF 500 Connectors
programme.desc: Like anything Festool, the system isn't cheap. But this Executive Desk is actually going to be my "lifetime" desk and build quality is a big priority, so I decided to give them a shot. The DF 500 Connectors have several configurations but I only needed one for my desk, and that's what I'll show you here.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Get Back Dining Table
programme.desc: The smartest, most durable, fun & useful space-saving table, built using white oak and the Swing-Out Seat Table Hardware Kit from Get Back Inc.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tricking Out a Cheap Desk
programme.desc: Instead of replacing a cheap desk, let's see if we can trick it out and make it more functional.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: AWFS 2007 Special - Part 2 of 2
programme.desc: In this special, Marc visits AWFS to learn firsthand from manufacturers about their new and innovative products.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: New Festool Tools
programme.desc: Festool recently released two new routers, the MFK700 and the OF2200, and a new multi-function table, the MFT3. Judging from the emails I’ve received, there is a lot of interest in seeing these items on the show. So this one is for you guys!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Taper Maker
programme.desc: Make your own tapering sled using our plans and hardware kit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Guild to Woodworking Clamps aka The Big Squeeze
programme.desc: Not sure what woodworking clamps to buy? In this episode, Marc will answer all your questions and guide you to the best clamps!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Craft Cart
programme.desc: A simple and functional craft cart that will help keep your kitchen table clean!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Tops - Ends - Finish
programme.desc: The table top and bench tops come together along with the breadboard ends. Watco Teak Oil is used for the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Festool CMS Router Table
programme.desc: Festool's new CMS Router Table hits the market in October 2012. Here's a first look at some of the main features and add-ons!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woodworking in America 2010
programme.desc: This was my first WIA and my expectations were building all year long. I even vowed to skip IWF (the big tool show in Atlanta), just to make sure I could focus all my attention on this education-focused conference. And am I ever glad I did!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Repurposed Outdoor Coffee Table
programme.desc: An old table has a new life as a coffee table.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 11
programme.desc: I resaw the spalted maple panels on the bandsaw using Laguna’s Resaw King. What a bandsaw blade! I then glue up the doors and begin creating the ebony plugs for the case. I finish up by showing my process for fitting inset doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Setting Up a Dado Blade
programme.desc: A hassle-free method for setting up a dado blade with no measuring! All it takes is a flat surface and one of the most sensitive measuring devices in your shop: your fingers!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tool Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: Tool storage is a challenge for any workshop. My current dilemma is how to store my portable power tools so that they are out of their cases and accessible. There is no one-size-fits-all solution, but I hope sharing my thoughts on this topic will at least get your gears turning so you can tackle the storage challenges in your own shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Refinish & Repurpose Cabinet Doors aka From Southwest to Contemporary
programme.desc: My mom's house is full of cabinet doors that were made in a Southwestern style and its time for a change. REPlacing the cabinets is certainly an option and just rEPlacing the doors alone would work too. But what if we could use our woodworking skills to modify the doors instead.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 2018 Holiday Gift Guide
programme.desc: Our annual holiday gift guide with some of our favorite woodworking gifts.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Drawbored Mortise & Tenon
programme.desc: The mortise and tenon is one of the strongest fundamental joints available to woodworkers, but there are a couple of ways we can make the joint even stronger and longer-lasting.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Quick High-Quality Shop Cabinets
programme.desc: A new set of custom cabinets with oodles of storage!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Drill Charging Station & DowelMax
programme.desc: I realized I needed a better way to store my drills and chargers. This simple wall-hanging “box” did the trick. I also wanted to make the project fast and easy, so I decided to try out the DowelMax for the first time. The system is a breeze to use and produces strong reliable joints in just a fraction of the time it takes to create a traditional mortise and tenon.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: In-Drawer Knife Block
programme.desc: A handy and safe way to organize kitchen knifes inside a drawer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Build a Blanket Ladder
programme.desc: Nicole joins me for a new beginner series of projects starting with a handy blanket ladder.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - My Mistakes
programme.desc: In the years since I started woodworking, I have only had a few close calls. Fortunately, most of my injuries have been minor. Most of those injuries took place early in my career before I knew anything about anything. This video will show you some of the stupid mistakes I’ve made, what happened to me, and how I avoid repeating those mistakes.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Moving Experience
programme.desc: Moving an entire wood shop is no fun. But you can save yourself a lot of backaches if you hire some help. Money well-spent if you ask me. I'll show you everything I did to get my shop ready for the road trip. By no means is this meant to be a guide of any sort. Rather, its just a peek into my personal experience. And if you ever have to move your own shop, you’ll know what you’re in for.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Safety Week 2008
programme.desc: Woodworker’s Safety Week is finally here! No it doesn’t mean that this is the only week we have to be safe, haha. Obviously, our shops are full of danger. So its very important that we adopt the safest practices possible. And with so many folks new to the hobby, its critical that we take a step back occasionally and focus on safety.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Advent Calendar Part 1
programme.desc: This Advent calendar is relatively basic in design, but has 25 little cubbies with enough room for a special treat or a secret message. In the first part of the two-part series, I start working on the grid structure and the hanging of the doors. The grid structure is creating using a shop-made jig that is very similar to a box-joint jig.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Make a Vacuum Bag aka A Pressing Matter
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to make your own vacuum bag for veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Finishing the Arts & Crafts Table
programme.desc: In this episode, Marc shows how to add a curve to the bottom rails and the sides of your arts & crafts table.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 1
programme.desc: Its no secret that Google SketchUp is a very popular program amongst woodworkers. Considering what it does, its incredibly easy to use. But it can still be intimidating to someone who is using it for the first time. So with the help of my buddy Aaron Marshall, we put together a few videos showing how to construct the square lid to the Steamer Trunk.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 4-In-A-Row Game
programme.desc: This 4-In-A-Row Game is fun for the whole family and can be made with basic materials and tools. If you're not familiar with this classic game, the goal is to achieve four discs in a row while blocking your competitor from doing the same. The fact that it's oversized makes it that much more fun.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Interview with Kaleo Kala
programme.desc: A chat with woodworker and designer, Kaleo Kala.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bit Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: A wall-hanging cabinet to help you organize and store your drill and router bits.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cool Miter Clamping Trick
programme.desc: A simple jig that will help you clamp large miter joints, such as those found in Mid-Century Modern furniture.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Backlit LED Poster Frame Light Box
programme.desc: Nicole and I love movies and we are lucky to have our own home theater room. Just outside that room, is a recess with an outlet on the wall intended for a back-lit poster frame. The one that came with the house was made with fluorescent tubes and was falling apart. So this is my replacement. It features a dimmable LED light strip and a double-sided poster and accEPts 27″ x 40″ posters.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Quick and Dirty 2lb Cut of Shellac
programme.desc: If you ever research mixing shellac, you were probably overwhelmed with information about precise measurements, including weights and volumes. More fun ensues when you want to learn how to go from one dilution to another. If you aren't familiar with shellac dilutions, here's the quick primer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning Water Into Oil
programme.desc: I get quite a few questions about water-based finishes and how to make them look more like oil-based finishes. It’s a common problem since water-based finishes are “water-white,” which means they don’t impart any color to the wood and have the potential to leave the surface looking lifeless and boring. In this video, I show you three different ways to treat the wood surface so that even WITH a water-based topcoat, the wood looks more like an oil-based finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 5
programme.desc: I'll show you how I use a Kutzall carving burr and a die grinder to blend in the protruding center piece, and I discuss the creation of the template for the top. I also show you how I rout the grooves for the steel dowels that will suspend the tabletop in the middle of the piece (you’ll understand when you see it).

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: David Marks Project in Progress
programme.desc: This is a quick tour of David Marks project in progress. David loves to make massive turned sculptures and his current project is a doozie! It’s a huge disc-shaped turned piece featuring a big marquetry image on the front. I hope you enjoy this as much as I did. It’s almost like an episode of Woodworks! Well, sort of.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 2
programme.desc: I discuss sliding dovetails and show you how to make them. I also cover finessing the dovetail’s fit and some special techniques for creating a stopped sliding dovetails.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 10 Things I Wish I Knew When I Started Woodworking
programme.desc: Some tips that might save you some heartache, time and money.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: River Bend Windsor Chair Kit
programme.desc: My friends at the Woodwerks Supply in Ohio sent me one of their new River Bend Windsor Chair Kits. This video outlines the process of putting this kit together and I even go so far as to give you a few compelling reasons why a kit like this makes sense for new AND experienced woodworkers alike!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Dream Closet Build Part 1
programme.desc: Making my wife a dream closet to replace the builder grade wire shelving.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Classy Headphone Controller Rack
programme.desc: An elegant and simple rack that holes a game controller and a set of headphones.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Waterborne Finishes & HVLP
programme.desc: Technically, this is really Part 4 of our Wall-Hanging Tool Chest build, but because I focused so strongly on waterborne finishes and HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure spraying), it received its own stand-alone title.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Low Entertainment Center Part 1
programme.desc: Think you can’t build furniture because you only have a few basic tools? Well, check this out! This walnut low entertainment center was built using three primary tools: a circular saw, a router, and a drill. The unit has sliding doors, good ventilation, a little shelf in the back for a surge protector, and all of the trim is beveled at an angle for a more interesting visual effect

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flatten Boards Wider Than Your Jointer
programme.desc: I'm going to show you two techniques that will help you keep your wide boards intact. Both methods utilize the planer for final flattening, but one method starts with a hand plane and the other starts with the jointer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Natural Wood Color Changes aka A Colorful Conversation
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the science of natural wood color changes.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 12
programme.desc: Well I finally made it to the finish line. This episode covers the hinge installation, pegging the tenons in the doors, making custom ebony handles, and finishing. I end the video with a justification of my design.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Dining Chair
programme.desc: You might recall the Gaming Dining Table I built in season 9. Ever since then, Nicole has been asking repeatedly, "When do I get my chairs?" So I started designing a new chair that I'd eventually batch out for a total of six. The video I've assembled here is a quick look at the process of designing and building the chair.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Outdoor Finishes - Real World Results
programme.desc: A look at how my outdoor projects have fared over the years.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 3
programme.desc: In the final part of our series, Aaron puts the finishing touches on the trunk lid. If this is your first experience with SketchUp, I highly recommend checking out the tutorials located at Sketch Up For Woodworkers

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rocking Horse Part 2
programme.desc: The second and final video in this series covers finishing and assembly. As with any project, you should always ask yourself if it might be better to pre-finish the parts. Since the rocking horse would be incredibly difficult to finish after assembly and all of our parts are screwed together, pre-finishing was a no-brainer.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Juan Diego le pregunta a Yubiri si quiere ir al cumpleaños de Cowalscky. Ella le dice que tiene un compromiso. El le anota la dirección y le dice que si pueda que vaya. Solymar llega a la plaza y los muchachos están un poco desanimados porque no ha llegado gente. Wilker le pregunta por Yubiri y ella le dice que ya debe estar por llegar. La cena de Armando | Briggite | Atanasio y Gisela están en punto efervescente. Briggite y Gisela se tiran bombas y bombas.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina está desconsolada al saber que está embarazada de Gerson porque no tiene ninguna esperanza de buena vida y la Miss intenta consolarla. Por otro lado, Matilde y Moncho quieren renunciar y Marco Aurelio está muy sorprendido por la decisión de ambos

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.desc: Walter llega a la casa de Felix y Luis Guillermo para anunciarles que Betania decidió divorciarse rápidamente y para decirles que Inés se está marchando a Nueva York para siempre. Alfredo está feliz porque ve a su hija en el retén y Diego Andrés llega para felicitarlo y pedirle que le conceda el divorcio a Marisela. Inés llega al aeropuerto y se entera que quien se va en su lugar es Betania y le deja el camino libre con Luis Guillermo quien llega a buscarlo y unos meses después, se preparan las bodas de Marisela y Diego Andrés y de Luis Guillermo con Inés y Daniela se queda a vivir en Miami, donde vive a cuerpo de reina como ella siempre quiso y le cuenta a su hermana que no piensa regresar nunca más a Venezuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior corteja a Rosa rumbo a la residencia, pero ella lo rechaza recordando la muerte de su hermano. Maricela ataca a Adolfo en plena ebriedad delante de Andreína y Rosalía. Rosa, ilusionada con Alejandro, lo ve partir sin saber que él fue a un compromiso forzado. Consuelo discute con Rosa creéndola ladrona, sin sospechar que es su hija perdida; luego se arrepiente. Eustoquio, instigado por Erasto, revela a Isaías que Consuelo tuvo una hija con Adolfo, sembrando el odio que destruirá a la familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Luego de la pelea en el baño con Alejandra, Irene decide regresar a su casa sin decirle a Leonardo. Ahí, su hermana Lucía le confiesa que Rodrigo Basáñez la ha estado amenazando. Agustina recibe una extraña llamada telefónica de alguien que decía ser su difunta hermana, lo cual la angustia muchísimo, ya que ese día iba a preparar una cena especial en honor a ella. Maribel le pide a Tony que revisen las cámaras de seguridad para comprobar la inocencia de Irene, pero a él se le ocurre una mejor idea para desenmascarar a Alejandra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Luego de que Ana muriera, Sol comienza a temer aún más por su vida. El comisario Tavares considera el asesinato como una sospecha más en contra de la familia Monserrat y Alejandro sigue negando la posibilidad de que su madre esté detrás de todo eso. Eloy está dispuesto a aclarar la situación entre él y Columba. No quiere andar escondiéndose. Al encontrarse con José Domingo, Eloy le dice que piensa hacer de Columba su esposa. José Domingo va donde Columba y le dice que no tiene ninguna objeción.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene insiste en que Leonardo debe creer en su inocencia sin necesidad de pruebas. Él va a casa de su madre a buscarla, pero, tras una charla larga, ella decide tomarse un tiempo para que ambos reflexionen. Leonardo no está presente la noche de la ceremonia en memoria de Rebeca, porque fue con Anzola a buscar a Irene. Agustina se enfurece y promete revelar un secreto terrible a la familia. Camacho, quien trabaja bajo las órdenes de Rodrigo, planea entrar al departamento de las Gutiérrez y llevarse los documentos por la fuerza. Pero la llegada de Leonardo se lo impide. Sandra le pide a María Lucía que le cuente todo sobre el chico que conoció en la universidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro va en busca de Sol para sacarla de la cárcel y así cuidarla a ella y al bebé. Luego de una larga charla, Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que el hijo que está esperando es suyo. Maricielo sigue con el corazón roto, y Alicia decide prepararle una cita con Víctor Hugo. Eloy Arturo presenta los papeles del divorcio y habla con Reina para comunicárselo. Reina le advierte que, dentro de algunos meses, él tendrá que cambiar de idea. Giselle quiere quedar embarazada de Cristo José.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se encuentran de regreso a su casa y comienzan los dos a decirse mentiras Carolina todavía sigue brava con Juan Diego por lo de Yubiri pero terminan besándose. Dionisia le cuenta el cuento de ROKUro a Briggite. Llega Carolina y piensa que las flores son para ella. Briggite la saca del error. En la casa de Bienvenida todos están tristes por el caso de Mayerlin. Yubiri comienza a hablar con el cuadro de Alejandro Fernández contándole como le fue el día y todo le fue malo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina encuentra a la esposa de Gerson vendiendo periódicos y aprovecha la oportunidad para despistarla sobre su gusto por él, pero sospecha algo. La esposa de Theo le pregunta a María Antonia qué le pasó en la pierna sin saber que fue a causa de él.

programme.title: Episodio 1
programme.desc: El amor entre Ricardo y Manuela florece, pero Celia, furiosa y vengativa, planea destruirlos. Tras recibir una llamada amenazante de Celia, Ricardo decide adelantar su boda para demostrarle su amor a Manuela. Mientras tanto, Katiuska regresa dispuesta a apoderarse de la fortuna Tariffi y del corazón de Ricardo. A pesar de los complots y súplicas desesperadas en su contra, Ricardo y Manuela logran casarse, pero el pasado se hace presente arruinando su luna de miel.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Isaías cae víctima de un asalto violento orquestado por Eustoquio. Alejandro, dividido, se confiesa con Amalia y conquista a Rosa con besos furtivos. Carmen rechaza a Junior por su vínculo con la muerte de Carlos. Maricela, fingiendo arrepentimiento, contrata un detective para investigar a Consuelo. Isaías, enardecido por las revelaciones de Eustoquio, exige a Consuelo la verdad sobre Adolfo. Erasto, decidido a vengar la deshonra de su hija, enfrenta a Adolfo en su propia empresa retando abiertamente al hombre que considera su peor enemigo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene insiste en que Leonardo debe creer en su inocencia sin necesidad de pruebas. Él va a casa de su madre a buscarla, pero, tras una charla larga, ella decide tomarse un tiempo para que ambos reflexionen. Leonardo no está presente la noche de la ceremonia en memoria de Rebeca, porque fue con Anzola a buscar a Irene. Agustina se enfurece y promete revelar un secreto terrible a la familia. Camacho, quien trabaja bajo las órdenes de Rodrigo, planea entrar al departamento de las Gutiérrez y llevarse los documentos por la fuerza. Pero la llegada de Leonardo se lo impide. Sandra le pide a María Lucía que le cuente todo sobre el chico que conoció en la universidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro va en busca de Sol para sacarla de la cárcel y así cuidarla a ella y al bebé. Luego de una larga charla, Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que el hijo que está esperando es suyo. Maricielo sigue con el corazón roto, y Alicia decide prepararle una cita con Víctor Hugo. Eloy Arturo presenta los papeles del divorcio y habla con Reina para comunicárselo. Reina le advierte que, dentro de algunos meses, él tendrá que cambiar de idea. Giselle quiere quedar embarazada de Cristo José.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se encuentran de regreso a su casa y comienzan los dos a decirse mentiras Carolina todavía sigue brava con Juan Diego por lo de Yubiri pero terminan besándose. Dionisia le cuenta el cuento de ROKUro a Briggite. Llega Carolina y piensa que las flores son para ella. Briggite la saca del error. En la casa de Bienvenida todos están tristes por el caso de Mayerlin. Yubiri comienza a hablar con el cuadro de Alejandro Fernández contándole como le fue el día y todo le fue malo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene decide no regresar con Leonardo por el momento. Virginia y Maribel, al verla tan triste, organizan un picnic familiar, con la ayuda de Felipe, quien no puede ocultar lo que siente por Irene. Virginia se entera de que Alejandra Altamirano y Rodrigo Basañez son amantes. Leonardo está terriblemente angustiado y le pide a Trinidad que hable con Irene. El cuadro de Rebeca aparece estropeado y Agustina, en una crisis nerviosa, culpa a Trinidad, quien decide regresar a su casa. Ricardo invita a María Lucía a pasar el sábado en el club donde van sus padres. Alejandra se le insinúa a Leonardo en su casa, e Irene los ve.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Giselle desaparece en un accidente de avión y Rika no se resigna a darla por muerta. Le informan que aparecieron los restos del avión junto a los huesos de los tripulantes pero no hay noticias del cuerpo de Giselle. En ese mismo instante Rika decide ir a la selva a buscarla personalmente. Sol y Aída están a punto de dar a luz, ambas son trasladadas a la misma clínica y Reina está detrás de todo esto. Ella tiene planes malvados para Sol y su bebé. Heriberto queda libre.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila insists that the imprisoned woman is her mother and Mother Isabel tells her that Rosa Blanco, imprisoned for murdering a man, is not her mother. Fate intertwines the warring families. Search for the identity of "El Doliente".

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel proposes to meet Camila at a dinner to tell her that he is going to get "her mother" out of jail. Mother Isabel only wants Camila to be happy and for that she recommends her to start a family.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila is happy because her mother is finally free, but Max is still hesitant. Reunited, she wants to know why he abandoned her and the woman pretends not to remember those painful moments. He abandons her for the second time. It is a very strong blow.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Justicia divina: Vronski, desesperado por encontrar una solución a su situación insostenible, viaja a visitar a su madre en busca de dinero. Anna interpreta su partida como la peor traición a su amor…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Encuentro en la estación: Anna Arkadievna Karenina, esposa de un alto funcionario del gobierno, llega a Moscú para ayudar a su hermano Stiva en una difícil situación familiar. En la estación de tren, conoce por casualidad al joven y distinguido oficial Alexéi Alexandrovich Vronski…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Las carreras de oficiales: Karenina y Vronski se reencuentran durante una competencia ecuestre. Un desafortunado error de Vronski provoca la caída y muerte de su caballo. Profundamente afectada por la escena, Anna pierde el conocimiento y, en su angustia, le confiesa todo a su esposo…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: La boda: El terrateniente Levin le propone matrimonio por segunda vez a Kiti Shcherbátskaya, y en esta ocasión, ella acepta…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Esa no soy yo: Anna da a luz a una niña. Dos pensamientos la atormentan: la culpa hacia su esposo y el miedo a la muerte durante el parto. Finalmente, consigue que su marido perdone a Vronski…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Justicia divina: Vronski, desesperado por encontrar una solución a su situación insostenible, viaja a visitar a su madre en busca de dinero. Anna interpreta su partida como la peor traición a su amor…

programme.title: Amada
programme.desc: Semyon Tarasov era una gerente exitoso, que hace un año dejo su trabajo el hipermercado “La Almohada favorita”. Después de culminar sus estudios y prácticas en el extranjero regresó a trabajar a la misma empresa, pero ya como director de la sucursal. Antes le llamaban simplemente Syoma, ahora debían llamarle por su nombre y patronímico, es decir, Semyon Olegovich. ¡Pero qué difícil es convencer a la gente de que ahora las reglas del juego han cambiado y que en lugar de un trato amistoso debería haber respeto! ¿Cómo inculcar asombro y respeto en los empleados? Aquí todos lo conocen como Syoma, el que animaba enérgicamente al equipo de fútbol en el bar con sus amigos, iba a hacer rafting en el río con otros, y con una mujer... con Lena ... Lena! Fueron pareja durante casi un año y vivían juntos, hasta que a Syoma le ofrecieron una pasantía. Él y Lena se amaban, y luego... ¿Qué pasó entonces? Entonces Syoma se convenció a sí mismo de que no se amaban en lo absoluto, sino que se tenían afecto, intimidad y una vida juvenil juntos. Se convenció de esto a sí mismo para no sentirse un vil traidor, porque sabía que había dejado a Lena por su carrera. Y Syoma realmente no falló en al lograr sus sueños. ¿y que paso con Lena? a Syoma se le olvidó lo hermosa que es. ¡Pero qué es esto! ¿Lena... está embarazada? Syoma cuenta frenéticamente los meses y los días y comprende que no es posible que él sea el padre de este niño. Si en dado caso Lena estuviera embarazada y estuviera a punto de dar a luz, tendría solo nueve meses de embarazo, pero Syoma no ha estado en Moscú desde hace 12 meses!

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Una serie policíaca sobre un misterioso asesino en serie. Ver Enséñame a vivir online para descubrir qué es lo que impide a los civiles dormir tranquilos. Durante años, la ciudad fue pacífica antes de que llegara el asesino. Los habitantes de la ciudad se sentían seguros y protegidos, pero ahora todos temen por sus vidas. Las víctimas del asesino van en aumento. La policía consigue atrapar al presunto asesino y ponerlo entre rejas. El caso puede cerrarse, pero se produce otro asesinato. La gente está asustada. Un psiquiatra está listo para ayudar en la investigación. Está dispuesto a reunirse con el sospechoso. El criminal revela al médico una verdad aterradora y muy peligrosa.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación revela que hace 25 años hubo una serie de asesinatos con un modus operandi similar. El asesino, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua en prisión y recientemente solicitó libertad condicional, pero la comisión encabezada por Lavrov rechazó su solicitud. La relación entre Storozheva y Lavrov es tensa. Juntos visitan al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó en el caso original, pero este se niega a ayudar y actúa de manera sospechosa. Al vigilarlo, descubren su conexión con Gavrishin, quien en su momento fue el principal sospechoso de los asesinatos.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita se encuentra con la exesposa de Lavrov, Katya, para verificar su coartada. Convencida de su inocencia, informa a Nikushin, su superior, que Lavrov parece ser el verdadero objetivo del asesino y que su esposa podría ser la próxima víctima. Nikushin se encarga personalmente de la seguridad de Katya. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor que murió en la infancia. Por otro lado, Lavrov sospecha de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien sufre de trastorno de identidad disociativo.

Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita se encuentra con la exesposa de Lavrov, Katya, para verificar su coartada. Convencida de su inocencia, informa a Nikushin, su superior, que Lavrov parece ser el verdadero objetivo del asesino y que su esposa podría ser la próxima víctima. Nikushin se encarga personalmente de la seguridad de Katya. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor que murió en la infancia. Por otro lado, Lavrov sospecha de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien sufre de trastorno de identidad disociativo.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Una serie policíaca sobre un misterioso asesino en serie. Ver Enséñame a vivir online para descubrir qué es lo que impide a los civiles dormir tranquilos. Durante años, la ciudad fue pacífica antes de que llegara el asesino. Los habitantes de la ciudad se sentían seguros y protegidos, pero ahora todos temen por sus vidas. Las víctimas del asesino van en aumento. La policía consigue atrapar al presunto asesino y ponerlo entre rejas. El caso puede cerrarse, pero se produce otro asesinato. La gente está asustada. Un psiquiatra está listo para ayudar en la investigación. Está dispuesto a reunirse con el sospechoso. El criminal revela al médico una verdad aterradora y muy peligrosa.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación revela que hace 25 años hubo una serie de asesinatos con un modus operandi similar. El asesino, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua en prisión y recientemente solicitó libertad condicional, pero la comisión encabezada por Lavrov rechazó su solicitud. La relación entre Storozheva y Lavrov es tensa. Juntos visitan al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó en el caso original, pero este se niega a ayudar y actúa de manera sospechosa. Al vigilarlo, descubren su conexión con Gavrishin, quien en su momento fue el principal sospechoso de los asesinatos.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov descubre que estaba equivocado sobre Starostin. Nikushin esconde a Katya en un apartamento secreto y entre ellos surge una atracción. Lavrov empieza a sentirse vigilado, instala una cámara oculta en su oficina y, al revisar las grabaciones, reconoce a alguien entrando. Esa noche, aparece inesperadamente en la casa de Rita, causando un gran susto a su madre.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Nikushin consigue permiso para que Rita y Lavrov visiten a Kosarev en prisión. Durante una fiesta en honor al dueño de la clínica psiquiátrica, Lavrov confronta al desconocido que irrumpió en su oficina. Más tarde, él y Rita dejan la ciudad para entrevistarse con Kosarev. Mientras tanto, un desconocido irrumpe en el apartamento donde se esconde Katya.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: A través del análisis psicológico, Lavrov descubre que Kosarev conoce al verdadero asesino, pero se niega a revelar su identidad. Nikushin encuentra a Katya en un hotel. Un compañero de celda de Kosarev le entrega a Rita y Lavrov una carta que Kosarev intentó destruir. Aunque el remitente usa una dirección falsa, la información hace que Lavrov sospeche de Nikushin.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov intenta advertir a Katya del peligro, pero ella no le cree. Rita, por su parte, duda de la culpabilidad de Nikushin. Mientras Lavrov investiga el pasado de Nikushin, Rita sigue una pista sobre la posible implicación de medicamentos en los asesinatos en serie. Katya le confiesa a Nikushin que en el pasado ya intentaron asesinarla. Esa misma noche, otra mujer es asesinada.
